answer_1.quote: ACE uses the annotation categories to identify users' mistakes and then provides targeted feedback based on the error definitions, along with in-context examples of feedback written by experts.

answer_4.quote: For each model we tested (GPT-4, GPT-4o, and GPT-3.5) we generated 10-15 examples of output and presented them to two experts who then selected which output they preferred.
answer_4.guideline: Our evaluations showed that GPT-4 and GPT-4o performed the best and we ultimately chose GPT-4o due to its speed.
